summary: Four games were played. Jayson Tatum scored 40 and hit a jumper at the end of overtime to give Boston a 125-124 win over Brooklyn. Luka Dončić scored 41 for the Lakers, but Portland won 136-129 with a late push in the fourth quarter. San Antonio beat Sacramento 130-103 behind 29 points from Victor Wembanyama, and New York beat Detroit 111-97 after a 37-13 third quarter.

games.headline: Tatum's jumper at the horn beats Nets 125-124 in OT
games.story: Brooklyn led 61-56 at halftime and Boston led 86-82 after three quarters, and the teams were tied 117-117 with one second left in regulation. In overtime the Nets went ahead 124-123 with 1:02 to play. Jayson Tatum then hit a 17-foot jumper as time expired, assisted by Derrick White, to win it 125-124. Tatum finished with 40 points, 18 of them on 18-of-22 free throw shooting, plus 8 assists. Michael Porter Jr. scored 27 with 12 rebounds and six three-pointers for Brooklyn, and Julius Randle had 24 points.

games.headline: Knicks outscore Pistons 37-13 in the third, win 111-97
games.story: Detroit led 38-25 after the first quarter, and the game was tied 50-50 with two seconds left in the first half before New York took a 51-50 lead into the break. The Knicks then outscored the Pistons 37-13 in the third quarter and led 88-63 going into the fourth. Their lead reached 27 early in the fourth. Karl-Anthony Towns had 27 points and 20 rebounds, and Jalen Brunson scored 23 with 13 made free throws. Paul Reed led Detroit with 22 points on 9-of-12 shooting, and the Pistons did not have Jalen Duren.

games.headline: Spurs open fast, rout Kings 130-103
games.story: San Antonio went ahead for good at 27-25 late in the first quarter and led 39-29 after one. The Spurs outscored Sacramento 41-25 in the second quarter to lead 80-54 at halftime, and the margin peaked at 28 in the third quarter. Victor Wembanyama had 29 points on 14-of-21 shooting, 10 rebounds and 5 blocks in under 27 minutes, and Julian Champagnie made 8 of 13 three-pointers for 26 points. De'Andre Hunter scored 24 for the Kings, who were without Keegan Murray and Ben Simmons.

games.headline: Blazers hold off Lakers 136-129 despite Dončić's 41
games.story: Los Angeles led by as many as 11 in the first quarter and held a 103-102 edge after three, but the game was tied 121-121 with 3:49 left in the fourth. Portland scored the next three points and led for the rest of the game, getting as far ahead as 8 with 7:56 left in a fourth quarter it won 34-26. Luka Dončić scored 41 for the Lakers with six three-pointers and 9 assists, and Austin Reaves added 26. Deni Avdija had 23 points and 9 assists for Portland, with Ja Morant also scoring 23 on 9-of-13 shooting.
